value.name: Rosa invites Asha inside
value.description: Rosa tells Asha to come in out of the rain and says Lucia is in the kitchen.
evidence: "Come in out of the wet," Rosa said. "Lucia's in the kitchen."

value.name: Asha notices the house's lived-in state
value.description: Asha takes in the house's smells, old wallpaper, and lingering belongings, revealing the home as long inhabited and recently unsettled.
evidence: The house smelled of coffee and lemon polish and, underneath, the particular dust of rooms that have been lived in for fifty years by the same person.
The foyer wallpaper was a faded green with cranes on it.
A coat rack near the door still held a camel coat that did not belong to anyone present.

value.name: Asha notices Daniel's reaction to the coat
value.description: Asha sees Daniel glance at the unfamiliar camel coat and then look away, suggesting the coat has emotional significance.
evidence: Asha noticed Daniel glance at it and then away.

value.name: Daniel identifies the coat as his mother's
value.description: Daniel explains that the camel coat belonged to his mother and says they have not yet gone through her things.
evidence: "Mom's," he said, before she could ask. "We haven't gone through her things yet."

value.name: Asha offers reassurance about sorting belongings
value.description: Asha responds that there is no hurry to go through the dead woman's things, speaking from her professional habit but unintentionally making the moment heavier.
evidence: "There's no hurry on that part," Asha said.
It was the kind of sentence she said often in her work, and she meant it, but it landed in this hallway with a weight she had not intended.

value.name: Daniel moves toward the parlor
value.description: After Asha's remark, Daniel heads toward the parlor without engaging further.
evidence: Daniel was already moving toward the parlor.

value.name: Lucia rises awkwardly to greet Asha
value.description: In the kitchen, Lucia stands up too quickly when Asha enters, as if she has been caught doing something.
evidence: Lucia was sitting at the kitchen table with her hands around a mug, and when Asha came in she stood up too quickly, as if she had been caught doing something.

value.name: Asha observes Lucia's grief and borrowed clothing
value.description: Asha notices Lucia's red eyes, younger age, and oversized sweater, and suspects the sweater belonged to the dead woman.
evidence: She was younger than Daniel by perhaps eight years, with the same long bones and a different face entirely, less polished, less defended.
Her eyes were red but not currently wet.
She had a sweater on that was much too big and that Asha suspected had also belonged to the dead woman.

value.name: Lucia addresses Asha formally
value.description: Lucia calls Asha 'Ms. Devi,' signaling distance and deference.

value.name: Asha invites first-name basis
value.description: Asha tells Lucia to call her Asha, attempting to soften the interaction.

value.name: Lucia withholds a handshake
value.description: Lucia only nods instead of offering her hand, then sits back down, maintaining emotional distance.
evidence: She did not offer her hand, only nodded, and sat back down.
